name: Sanguinette
description: A sanguinette is the result of a humanoid female who was infected with vampirism but not successfully turned. These wretched creatures grow deadly claws and fangs, coarse fur and large ears which they use to echolocate their prey. Like their undead kin, sanguinettes persist on a diet of blood and hide in the dark awaiting the unlucky beast or humanoid that happens to wander their way.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The sanguinette bites a creature, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the attack deals true damage instead and the sanguinette gains health equal to the amount of damage dealt.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: The sanguinette makes an attack with their claw, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target gains the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Offhand Claw
actions.description: After using the Claw action, the sanguinette strikes with their offhand claw, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target gains the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Glide
actions.description: After using the Move action, the sanguinette uses its momentum to leap into the air and glide an additional 4 units of flight speed using its pseudo-wings.

actions.name: Lunge
actions.description: In response to a medium or smaller creature moving within 4 units of it, the sanguinette lunges at them, dealing physical damage and preventing any further movement. If the sanguinette is hidden, this attack deals an additional 1d8 damage and knocks the target prone upon hitting.

actions.name: Dual Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving it's area of control, the sanguinette makes an attack with it's Claw action, and then with it's Offhand Claw free action.

traits.name: Blood Splatter
traits.description: When the sanguinette deals damage to a creature that has the bleeding or wounded condition, that creature takes an additional 1d4 true damage.
